$comment: THE single source of truth for what AILGEN publishes. Read by two independent consumers: `node tools/publish.mjs plan` in the workstation, and .github/workflows/pages.yml in CI. One file, so a dry run and the actual build cannot disagree - a manifest that exists twice is a manifest that will be wrong in one of them.
$measured: Not guessed. Every internal href and src in index.html was extracted and counted: assets 19, data 131, brand 8, studio 7, switching-tv 1, vermeil 1. campaigns had ZERO references from the homepage and projects ZERO - so they are working material. campaigns is 179 MB of campaign sources; projects is 35 MB and contains browser render output under _eyes/. Neither is a page anyone can reach.
$excluded: campaigns, projects, tools, scripts, memory, .opencode, .claude, .githooks, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, opencode.json, package.json, package-lock.json. The workstation repository AILGENOPENCHAMBER stays private and is never published at all.
$blocklist: publish.mjs applies a second, independent blocklist on top of this manifest. A mistake in both is required to leak anything, because the failure mode - publishing the agent's own notes as a public URL - is not recoverable by deleting a file later.
